graduation_criteria.description: Discovery → Deployment 전환 조건. discovery_graduation_gate.sh 강제. v8.x WS2 재설계(2026-05-29): rank-IC 계열은 long-only 실현 alpha와 어긋나(16후보 calibration 실측: rank_ic가 FLOW 거짓탈락+NN/TECH 거짓통과) advisory로 강등, portfolio-alpha t(forge NW lag-3)를 hard로. DSR hard는 sweep형 selection만(2026-06-10 개정 — chain/단일은 advisory). hard 기준은 forge-authoritative 값(alpha-stage proxy 아님)에 적용.
graduation_criteria.min_rank_ic_rationale: KR top-universe benchmark. <0.04는 IC 약함. (v8.x severity=advisory — long-only 실현 alpha 미전이)
graduation_criteria.max_drawdown_days_rationale: 100일 이상 drawdown 지속 시 alpha decay 의심. (severity=advisory)
graduation_criteria.min_harvey_t_stat_rationale: rank-IC Harvey-t. (v8.x severity=advisory — rank-IC t는 portfolio-alpha t와 구분, 후자가 권위)
graduation_criteria.min_deflated_sharpe_ratio_rationale: Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR — multi-testing 보정 SR. (severity=HARD는 sweep형 selection만 — ML스윕/optimizer서치/앙상블·사전등록 grid. 가설주도 chain/단일검증은 advisory 강등+진단산출. 도훈 mandate 2026-05-31/2026-06-10, measurement-graduation §3)
graduation_criteria.min_portfolio_alpha_t_nw_rationale: ★v8.x 신규 HARD. forge-authoritative 실현 portfolio-alpha t (NW lag-3, forge_package.portfolio_alpha_t_nw_lag3). Harvey-Liu-Zhu 2016 hurdle. rank-IC t 아님. 게이트 핵심 판별(16후보 중 FLOW만 통과=정확).
graduation_criteria.severity_rationale: hard = block(우회불가), advisory = warn(screening). hard 2종(DSR/portfolio_alpha_t_nw)은 forge-authoritative 값에만 적용 — alpha-stage proxy로 graduation 선언 금지(v8.x WS1 정합).

hypothesis_description:
CHAIN ITERATION on WT-D20260621_009 (Buyback Yield Confirmed). That WT proved: monthly quarterly-CARRY buyback yield has a FLAT top (value-trap, D10 active -0.7%), BUT the FRESH-disclosure-month drift = +0.42%/mo vs carry-months -0.28%/mo. The Ikenberry buyback underreaction drift is REAL but short-lived (~1 month); monthly carry of QUARTERLY data dilutes it to zero. This is a construction problem, not a signal absence (AX-000 amended). selection_type='chain' (mechanism-diagnosis-driven construction fix, NOT a sweep -> DSR exempt; iteration selection IS-only, holdout once at end).

FROM kr-topconc-momentum-hunt backlog: C27_Buyback_Decision_Drift = #1 ranked (top_conc=5, mechanism=5). FULL spec at stage_artifacts/momentum_hunt/backlog_topconc.json -> specs[name='C27_Buyback_Decision_Drift']. READ IT.

CONCEPT: Buyback DECISION-announcement drift, EVENT-TIME CONTINUOUS construction via DART tsstkAqDecsn (자기주식취득 결정 공시 — board buyback DECISIONS, which occur CONTINUOUSLY through the year, unlike the quarterly stock_buyback.parquet panel which clusters ~4x/yr at Period_Date+45d). Each announcement = a discrete event at rcept_dt (PIT). Signal: hold announcing firms in a post-announcement DRIFT WINDOW (test 1/2/3 months), ranked by buyback INTENSITY (취득예정금액/Size, 직접취득 method weighted), equal-weight top-25 (or all event-cohort names if <25). This is the continuous event-driven construction that captures the 1-month Ikenberry drift the WT_009 quarterly-carry destroyed.

WHY THIS / TOP-CONCENTRATION: a board buyback decision is a genuine BINARY occurrence -> non-event names get structural zero -> only event firms populate the top, D10 = largest-intensity direct-method buybacks. Buy-side only -> escapes AX-007 (the wall that stranded the prior 10 concepts' real signals in short/mid-decile). WT_009's fresh-month +0.42% is the empirical motivation; DART decisions give the continuous event stream the quarterly panel lacks.

BUILD: extract DART tsstkAqDecsn (corp buyback-decision disclosures): rcept_dt (announcement, PIT), 취득예정금액 (planned amount), 취득방법 (direct/trust), 취득기간. Map corp_code->Ticker. Build event table 2005+ (flag pre-2015 coverage thinning honestly). Each month t: cohort = firms with rcept_dt in (t-K, t]; score = intensity; top-25 EW; forward 1M net active. Grid: drift window K in {21d,42d,63d}, intensity {planned_amt/Size, direct-method-only}, top_n {15,25}.

CRITICAL READS: (1) ★decile/concentration WITHIN event cohort — is the drift TOP-concentrated (high-intensity events) or uniform? D10 active t-stat + D10-D9 gap. (2) cohort breadth per month (DART decisions are continuous so should fill better than quarterly — report n_cohort/mo; if still lumpy, honest). (3) TURNOVER + net-of-15bps — monthly event rotation = high turnover; the +0.42%/mo gross MUST survive cost (this is the central risk vs WT_009). (4) does the drift decay — K=21d vs 63d.

ORTHOGONALITY (active -BM basis): vs M03/M06 momentum |corr|<=0.40, value/EP <=0.35, Size <=0.35. EXPECTED_ROLE: buy-side event-driven drift, top-concentration via event gate. PIT: rcept_dt PIT announcement (C2/C5 — NOT effective/period date), forward Ret_1m, cross-sectional per-month (C1), C13/C14/C15. long-only top-25, [0,0.20], 15bps, 2e8 liq.

HONEST RISK (AX-000 amended): (1) +0.42%/mo gross may NOT survive event-rotation turnover cost (the make-or-break vs WT_009). (2) DART extraction/coverage — pre-2015 thin, API parsing; if extraction blocks, report and fall back to the quarterly fresh-cohort proxy. (3) drift may concentrate in micro-caps (liquidity check). (4) decision != completion (announced buybacks not always executed) -> signal noise. Graduation NOT presumed; real-but-lumpy -> overlay/screen route. real-computation (canonical_screen_bt) ONLY; Codex Critic Round mandatory. R segfault guard.
